fees.notes: City University Malaysia does not publish an international fee schedule: the official International Students page states the latest fee structure is available only from the International Marketing Office (imo@city.edu.my) or CityU representatives on request, and the official programme page and programme listing show no tuition fee. Sources checked: https://city.edu.my/admission-scholarships/international-students/; https://city.edu.my/master-of-information-technology/; https://city.edu.my/programmes/masters-phd/ (all accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
